subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should configured TTS providers remain allowed to fall through to another provider after a primary failure or skip, or should selected-provider stickiness prevent fallback for auto-TTS/audio playback?
rationale: Current behavior is documented and tested fallback semantics, while the remaining request would intentionally change provider-selection policy and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Keep fallback default, add explicit stickiness
options.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain for existing users while adding a deliberate strict/no-fallback path only if maintainers want that behavior.

options.title: Make selected provider strict by default
options.body: Prevent surprising voices and paid-provider confusion, but accept that existing setups relying on fallback may stop producing audio.

options.title: Accept diagnostics as sufficient
options.body: Close the behavior request and keep current fallback semantics now that status and attempt details expose what happened.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback default, add explicit stickiness
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain for existing users while adding a deliberate strict/no-fallback path only if maintainers want that behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the diagnostic fixes and documented the remaining provider-stickiness boundary in the related issue and PR discussion.
